I can’t really shut my mouth in terms of what ENGENES can do for both fighting our country and fighting for the group they love. I hope Mx. Ashi reflect on the post that has been made.

I will still talk and fight for this, since I can’t leave this all arguments behind my back since I’m also a STUDENT-LEADER, LEADER THAT YOU CAN SEE ON THE STREETS, and a FAN.

Hi, Mx. Ashi/@bilogyu! I don’t know what you’re trying to prove with these non-sense argument of yours, but let me introduce you to what ENHYPEN and FILO ENGENES did in our country, and why ENHYPEN loves to go back always here. 

First thing, ENHYPEN donated 1 million korean won or worth 4 million pesos to support the FLOOD RECOVERY EFFORTS in the PHILIPPINES. 

Second, ENGENES are supported local NGOs and GOVERMENT SECTOR ORGANIZATIONS like Philippine Red Cross for their project which is Sandugo. 

Third, ENGENES do support nationwide protest for GOOD GOVERNANCE, we do also support the current issue right now which is the fundraising initiative for our jeepney drivers. 

I don’t really know where your arguments going to, but your arguments didn’t make sense at all. 

ENGENES really knows why ENHYPEN keeps going back here, due to genuine love and support of their fans, either its for the group or for to speak loudly on what’s happening at our country. 

These FANS that you’re referring to have produced a meaningful projects with other NGOs and credible organizations. Also, you can see them in the streets protesting for GOOD GOVERNANCE. You can check the photos below for credible proofs. I hope you do a BACKGROUND CHECK FIRST before tweeting a non-sense argument :).

I’ll leave a question for you @bilogyu, do you participate to voice out for our nation and can do fight for your favorite group? Also, if you really participate, the first thing that you’ll do is fact check. why you didn’t do that always?

From Norton AFB CA, we:
Low-approached a US Navy aircraft carrier in the Indian Ocean. (They asked for it!)
Had St Elmo’s Fire on our C-141’s nose
Visited Hiroshima - eerie
Visited Suicide Cliffs in Okinawa - sobering
Rode Jeepnies in the Philippines
Saw school kids lined along the taxiway to see our C-141 in Wellington, New Zealand
Overflew Niagara Falls & Mt St Helens
